rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with the provided 2AB description, especially the loose/sparse TE, but it over-interprets image details (irregular contour, non-crisp ICM, no degenerative features) from a single static image and uses some imprecise wording.

Integrates age, BMI, ovarian response, semen parameters, diagnosis, prior cycle history, and especially the very thin endometrium into prognosis; AMH is appropriately noted as unavailable. Could more explicitly separate embryo-intrinsic quality from uterine receptivity.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with the low implantation estimate tied to fair morphology and 4 mm lining. Minor issues include awkward/contradictory phrasing about embryo quality spectrum and some speculative comments about fresh-cycle hormonal causes.

Largely aligned with IVF practice: SET at age 28, caution with thin endometrium, avoid unproven add-ons, and no routine PGT-A in a first cycle. Slight downgrade because specific progesterone suggestions and some management comments are somewhat prescriptive without full cycle context.

Provides practical next steps including counseling about thin lining, considering freeze-all in future if lining remains poor, cavity assessment, luteal support review, and future male-factor workup if needed. Useful and nuanced, though some recommendations remain general rather than protocol-specific.
